description: The TN-45 RTO office serves the western region of Tiruchirappalli and is headquartered in Pirattiyur. It is a critical administrative hub for vehicle registration, licensing, and road safety enforcement for the western parts of the district including the Manapparai unit.
address: Regional Transport Office, Ground Floor & 1st Floor, Trichy-Dindigul Main Road, Pirattiyur, Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu
